tip.text: Hurls a hammer at an enemy. Enemies within 255 of the target take 100 / 175 / 250 / 325 magic damage and are stunned for 2 seconds.
tip.title: Vow Hammer

tip.text: Melee attacks also hit enemies within 200 of the target for 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% of their damage.
tip.title: Wide Arc

tip.text: Allied heroes within 700 gain 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 armor and 12% move speed for 6 seconds.
tip.title: Rallying Shout

tip.text: Raises attack damage by 100% / 125% / 150% for 25 seconds.
tip.title: Iron Oath

tip.text: Blasts enemies within 400 of a point for 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 magic damage. They are slowed by 30% move speed and 20 attack speed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5 seconds.
tip.title: Hoarfrost Burst

tip.text: Freezes an enemy in place for 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds. It cannot move or attack, and it loses 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 health over that time.
tip.title: Ice Shackle

tip.text: Allied heroes anywhere on the map regain 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 extra mana a second.
tip.title: Clear Mind

tip.text: Channels for up to 4 seconds. Every 0.1 seconds, an ice blast lands between 195 and 630 from Rime and hits enemies within 190 of it.
tip.title: Winter's Ring

tip.text: Sends a wave of fire 1075 forward. Each enemy it passes through takes 100 / 170 / 230 / 280 magic damage.
tip.title: Flame Wave

tip.text: After 0.5 seconds, fire strikes the ground. Enemies within 225 take 90 / 150 / 210 / 280 magic damage and are stunned for 1.6 seconds.
tip.title: Pillar of Flame

tip.text: Each spell Cinder casts gives her 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 attack speed and 3% / 4% / 5% / 6% move speed for 7 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.
tip.title: Kindled Step

tip.text: After 0.25 seconds, a lance of fire strikes one enemy for 450 / 675 / 950 magic damage.
tip.title: Searing Lance

tip.text: While on, each attack on an enemy costs mana and slows it by 10% / 20% / 30% / 40% for 1.5 seconds.
tip.title: Rimed Arrows

tip.text: Silences enemies within 275 of a point for 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 seconds. Silenced units cannot cast spells.
tip.title: Hush

tip.text: Ranged allies within 900 gain 7% / 14% / 21% / 28% of their base attack damage.
tip.title: Hunter's Eye

tip.text: Gives Thistle 15 / 30 / 45 agility.
tip.title: Steady Hand

tip.text: Throws a hook in a line. The first unit it hits is dragged back to Gristle, and an enemy takes 90 / 180 / 270 / 360 pure damage.
tip.title: Gutting Hook

tip.text: While on, enemies within 250 take 35 / 60 / 85 / 110 magic damage a second and are slowed by 20%. Gristle takes the same damage.
tip.title: Carrion Cloud

tip.text: Gives 4% / 8% / 12% / 16% magic resistance. Each enemy hero that dies within 450 of Gristle adds 0.9 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 1.8 strength for the rest of the game.
tip.title: Grave Bulk

tip.text: Channels on an enemy for up to 3 seconds. The enemy is stunned and takes 75 / 125 / 175 magic damage a second.
tip.title: Butcher's Feast

tip.text: Splits the ground in a line 1200 long. Enemies in it take 125 / 175 / 225 / 275 magic damage and are stunned for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 seconds. Rocks block the line for 8 seconds.
tip.title: Rift Stomp

tip.text: Tectus's next attack within 14 seconds deals 75% / 150% / 225% / 300% extra damage.
tip.title: Horn Charge

tip.text: Each spell Tectus casts deals 25 / 45 / 75 / 115 magic damage to enemies within 300 and stuns them for 0.3 / 0.7 / 1.2 / 1.5 seconds.
tip.title: Ground Tremor

tip.text: Deals 160 / 210 / 270 magic damage to enemies within 500. Each enemy hit takes 40 / 55 / 70 more for every other enemy hit.
tip.title: Resonant Slam

tip.text: Kestrel spins for 5 seconds, dealing 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 magic damage a second to enemies within 250. Spells cannot affect him while he spins, and he cannot attack.
tip.title: Whirling Edge

tip.text: Places a totem that follows Kestrel for 25 seconds. Allies within 500 of it regain 2% / 3% / 4% / 5% of their maximum health a second.
tip.title: Mending Totem

tip.text: Each attack has a 15% / 20% / 25% / 35% chance to deal 2x damage.
tip.title: Keen Edge

tip.text: Kestrel leaps between enemies within 425 up to 3 / 5 / 8 times, one strike every 0.4 seconds. Each strike deals 150 to 250 physical damage, and he cannot be harmed until it ends.
tip.title: Thousand Cuts

tip.text: Spikes erupt in a line 700 long. Enemies hit take 60 / 130 / 200 / 260 magic damage and are stunned for 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 seconds.
tip.title: Thornburst

tip.text: Turns an enemy into a harmless critter for 1.25 / 2 / 2.75 / 3.5 seconds. It cannot attack or cast spells.
tip.title: Toadcurse

tip.text: Channels on an enemy for up to 4 seconds, taking 20 / 40 / 60 / 120 mana a second from it. The link breaks if the enemy moves farther than 800 away or runs out of mana.
tip.title: Soul Siphon

tip.text: After 0.25 seconds, deals 500 / 650 / 850 magic damage to one enemy.
tip.title: Final Verdict

tip.text: After 0.8 seconds, shot rains on an area for 8 seconds. Enemies within 350 take 12 / 24 / 36 / 48 magic damage a second and are slowed by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30%.
tip.title: Scattershot

tip.text: Each attack has a 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% chance to deal 30 / 30 / 40 / 50 extra physical damage and stun the target for 0.01 / 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.2 seconds.
tip.title: Clean Shot

tip.text: Adds 65 / 130 / 195 / 260 to Longwick's attack range.
tip.title: Long Sight

tip.text: Takes careful aim, then fires at one enemy. The shot deals 355 / 505 / 655 magic damage and stuns for 0.1 seconds.
tip.title: Deadeye

tip.text: Strikes an enemy for 85 / 100 / 115 / 145 magic damage, then leaps to the nearest enemy within 500. It hits up to 5 / 7 / 9 / 15 enemies.
tip.title: Forked Spark

tip.text: Strikes an enemy for 100 / 175 / 275 / 350 magic damage and stuns it for 0.1 seconds.
tip.title: Skyfall Bolt

tip.text: Each spell Tempest casts takes 5% / 7% / 9% / 11% of the current health of each enemy within 1000 as magic damage.
tip.title: Charged Air

tip.text: Strikes every living enemy hero on the map for 210 / 335 / 460 magic damage.
tip.title: Stormcall

tip.text: Each attack has a 15% chance to deal 50 extra magic damage and stun the target for 1.65 seconds.
tip.title: Crushing Blow

tip.text: Hackle fights up close: 15 more damage, 3 more armor, 100 more health and 20 / 20 / 20 / 30 more move speed, and a 10% chance to deal 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 magic damage and stun for 0.8 / 1.2 / 1.6 / 2 seconds. Switch back to throw from range.
tip.title: Red Tusk

tip.text: Throws five hatchets in a cone 900 long. Enemies hit take 75 magic damage and are slowed by 30% for 3 / 3.75 / 4.5 / 5.25 seconds. Up close, the hatchets whirl round Hackle instead.
tip.title: Hatchet Storm

tip.text: Two hatchets whirl out to 450 round Hackle and back. Enemies they touch take 125 / 175 / 225 / 275 magic damage and miss 60% of their attacks for 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 seconds. From range, the hatchets fly in a cone instead.
tip.title: Hatchet Storm

tip.text: Each attack on the same target gives 20 more attack speed, up to 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 times. A new target starts the count again.
tip.title: Grudge

tip.text: Every allied hero on the map gains 60 / 100 / 140 attack speed for 5 seconds; Hackle for 10.
tip.title: War Drums

tip.text: Spins blades round Chipper, cutting trees and dealing 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 damage to enemies within 300: pure damage if a tree falls, magic damage if not. Enemy heroes lose 15% of their main attribute for 7 seconds.
tip.title: Splinter Spin

tip.text: Fires the chain claw up to 800 / 1000 / 1200 / 1400. It grabs the first tree near its path and pulls Chipper to it, dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 pure damage to enemies within 225 of his path. A stunned Chipper is not pulled.
tip.title: Grapple Claw

tip.text: Each attack on Chipper gives 1 armor and 1 health a second for 16 seconds, up to 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 at once.
tip.title: Thick Bark

tip.text: Fires the chest blade to a point, cutting trees and dealing 100 / 140 / 180 pure damage to enemies on the way out and back. There it spins, dealing 50 / 75 / 100 pure damage a second within 200 and slowing enemies by their missing health, while Chipper spends 20 / 30 / 40 mana a second. He cannot attack while it is out.
tip.title: Buzz Blade

tip.text: Calls the blade back to Chipper.
tip.title: Recall Blade

tip.text: Ice grips an enemy where it stands. It takes 37.5 / 50 / 62.5 / 75 magic damage 4 times, and if it is still within 740 of that spot after 4 seconds, it is stunned for 1.25 / 2 / 2.75 / 3.5 seconds.
tip.title: Frozen Ground

tip.text: A whirl of snow spins 275 round a point for 12 seconds. Enemies in it are slowed by 18% / 22% / 26% / 30% and lose 10% / 15% / 20% / 25% magic resistance.
tip.title: Snow Whirl

tip.text: Allied heroes within 450 of the point, Shiver too if it stands there, deal 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 more magic damage with each of their next 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 attacks on enemy heroes. Their attacks are 15% slower until the charges are spent or 40 seconds pass.
tip.title: Frost Talons

tip.text: Sends a star of hail toward a point anywhere on the map. Press again to burst it where it flies: the longer it flew, the wider the burst, from 225 to 1000. Enemies hit take 250 / 350 / 450 magic damage and 12.5 / 20 / 32 a second for 8 / 9 / 10 seconds, cannot heal, and die below 10% / 11% / 12% health.
tip.title: Hailstar

tip.text: Bursts the Hailstar where it is now. The hail falls from Shiver to that spot.
tip.title: Hailfall

tip.text: Throws an ember at one enemy. It deals 100 / 175 / 250 / 325 magic damage and stuns for 1.45 / 1.55 / 1.65 / 1.75 seconds.
tip.title: Ember Dart

tip.text: Sends a wave of dusk 1400 ahead. Each enemy it passes loses 18.75 / 37.5 / 56.25 / 75 health and 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 armor for 20 seconds.
tip.title: Dusk Wave

tip.text: Allies within 900, creeps too, gain 12% / 20% / 28% / 36% of their base attack damage.
tip.title: Lamplight

tip.text: Trades places with a hero, ally or enemy, even one immune to spells. Trees round both spots fall, and the hero's channel breaks.
tip.title: Moth Switch

tip.text: After a moment, stars strike every enemy within 625 for 75 / 150 / 225 / 300 magic damage. One enemy within 175 of Skipjack is struck again for 50% of that.
tip.title: Star Shower

tip.text: Shoots a long arrow that stops at the first enemy it meets and deals 90 / 180 / 270 / 360 magic damage. It stuns for 0.5 seconds, longer the farther it flew, up to 5 seconds.
tip.title: Comet Arrow

tip.text: Leaps 630 / 720 / 780 / 870 the way Skipjack faces. Where it lands, allied heroes within 775 gain 4% / 8% / 12% / 16% attack speed and 4% / 8% / 12% / 16% movement speed for 10 seconds.
tip.title: Lily Leap

tip.text: Every allied hero turns invisible for 11 seconds, after a fade of 2.5 / 2 / 1.5 seconds. Attacking or casting shows a hero again until it waits out the fade.
tip.title: Pond Mist
